title: Managers with the most Champions League games
brief: Name the ten managers who have taken charge of the most Champions League games since 1992/93.
period: Champions League seasons 1992/93 to 2025/26, group or league stage onwards; in 1992/93 and 1993/94 the first and second rounds count; games a manager missed through a touchline ban still count for him
sources: https://www.transfermarkt.com/<coach>/leistungsdatenDetail/trainer/<id>/saison_id/0/wettbewerb_id/CL (Transfermarkt list of every Champions League game for each manager)
https://match.uefa.com/v5/matches/<id>/lineups (UEFA line-ups, which name the coach on the bench, mostly from 2008/09)
checks: Game lists from Transfermarkt, each game matched to UEFA's results. Where UEFA line-ups name the coach (most games from 2008/09), they agree with Transfermarkt except games under a touchline ban, where UEFA names the assistant. Wikipedia's table (to September 2026) has the same top nine but counts differently: it leaves out banned games (Klopp 100, Simeone 128), counts 1993/94 first and second rounds as qualifying (Ferguson 190 at Man Utd) and includes 2026/27 games and pre-1992 European Cup games (Wenger, Hitzfeld). Hitzfeld, Van Gaal and Benitez share tenth on 95.
